title: Adaptive strict finalize v2r + 60s micro‑tail (1140s+60s; 30s segments, dK=12), artifact save
abstract: Runs v2r for 1140s (30s segments, dK=12) with strict feasibility projector each segment, then a 60s micro‑tail using active pair backtracking (k_pairs=216, α0=7e−5, boundary_push=0.70). Saves NPZ artifact.

original_submission.content:
import os, time, numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import active_quench_adaptive as AD
import active_quench as AQ

def construct_packing():
    seed = 20251210
    # 19 minutes of adaptive strict finalize
    C, r, S = AD.adaptive_finalize(
        total_sec=1140.0,
        seed=seed,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        eta_S=5e-6,
        eta_slack=1e-7,
        gamma_alpha=0.6,
        dK=12,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        alpha0_init=1.2e-4,
        boundary_push_init=0.64,
        boundary_push_min=0.58,
        pair_margin=5e-12,
        boundary_margin=2e-12
    )
    # 1 minute micro-tail polish
    C, r_tail, S_tail = AQ.active_pair_quench(
        C, budget_sec=60.0, seed=seed+1,
        k_pairs=216, alpha0=7e-5, backtrack=0.5, alpha_min=1e-6, boundary_push=0.70
    )
    # Final strict feasibility
    r = AD.finalize_feasible(C, r_tail, pair_margin=5e-12, boundary_margin=2e-12, max_iters=20)

    # Save artifact
    runs_dir = os.path.join("storage", "noesis", "pack", "runs")
    os.makedirs(runs_dir, exist_ok=True)
    score = float(np.sum(r))
    ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S", time.gmtime())
    np.savez(os.path.join(runs_dir, f"polished_adapt_v2r_tail_{ts}_S{score:.6f}.npz"),
             centers=C.astype(float), radii=r.astype(float), score=score)

    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,) and np.all(r > 0)
    return C, r
